title: Putin Says Russia Ready to Negotiate 'On the Basis of the Istanbul Agreements' of 2022
detail: June 23, 2026 — President Putin said Russia was ready to resume talks with Ukraine using the abandoned March 2022 Istanbul draft as the negotiating framework, under which Ukraine would renounce NATO membership and cap the size of its armed forces in exchange for security guarantees. Kyiv considers the 2022 draft outdated given battlefield and territorial changes since then, and Ukrainian officials did not embrace the proposal as a viable starting point. The remark came a day after the fourth call between Putin and Trump this year and reflected Moscow's continued preference for a framework negotiated under different military conditions.

title: EU and Taliban Hold First Officially Acknowledged Closed-Door Talks, in Brussels
detail: June 23, 2026 — A Taliban delegation held the first officially acknowledged closed-door talks with EU staff in Brussels, focused on 'dignified returns' of Afghan nationals and limited consular/diplomatic engagement. No EU member state formally recognizes the Islamic Emirate, and the EU stressed the talks were narrowly technical rather than a step toward recognition. The meeting nonetheless marked a notable expansion of Taliban engagement diplomacy with Western institutions since the 2021 takeover.
